_meta.supersedes: Plan v1.1 §1.1/§1.2: LV long-axis orientation refined (≈50° left of sagittal, ≈35° inferior, ≈17° anterior) so that PLAX is reachable with a near-perpendicular beam; LV ES length 7.2 cm with MAPSE 1.3 cm (was 7.5).
changelog: 0.2.0: heart moved 1.2 cm posterior (RV free wall was touching the chest wall; RV now ~2 cm deep in PLAX); descending aorta moved to stay just behind the LA; rib width 1.3→1.0 cm and AP thickness 1.0→0.8 cm (realistic intercostal windows); liver left lobe enlarged (subxiphoid window); lung cardiac notch enlarged (apical window opens in LLD). All found by rendering the views and tracing the centre scan line.

0.3.0: anatomy realism pass after staff-style review of renders — curved/tapered MV+TV leaflets with free-edge curl, AV cusp belly sag, bullet-shaped LV, organic atria (vestibules, PV ostia, LAA, SVC, RA appendage, carved IAS, LA–aorta wall), thicker pericardium; echo: myocardium/liver mottling. Pericardium thinner except posteriorly; leaflet width-arc (short-axis curvature). LA moved posterior (under the aortic root, as in PLAX); mitral annulus tilted; descending aorta moved posterior-left to stay behind the LA.

0.4.0 (P1.5, in progress): 3D heart meshed from the signed distance of the heart's outer surface (gHeartD) at 0.13 cm, bake skips the body wall (the anterior RV had been cut flat by the chest-wall layer). Base of the heart re-laid round the aortic root (clock face from above): LA moved behind the root at sinus level (no false-ASD look in PLAX), PV anterior-left of the AV, RVOT/conus a curved tube from the TV side over the front of the aorta to the PV (PSAX-AV: RV/RVOT wraps the Mercedes sign), LAA a tapering finger beside the PA trunk, LVOT a tube along the aortic axis with the basal IVS continuing into the anterior aortic wall and the AML hinged on the posterior aortic annulus. New label ids LA_wall, RA_wall (IAS now only where both atria meet). Views: PLAX beam ⟂ the LV–aorta bisector; plane3 lateral now lies in the derived plane (side landmark only picks the sign); A4C notch side = LV_lateral_mid.

0.4.0 (P1.5, atria): LA and RA enlarged to Lang 2015 sizes (ED semi LA 2.3/1.8/2.6, RA 2.0/1.8/2.5 cm; verify) and re-placed beside each other near the A4C plane, so A4C shows both atria with the IAS between them; RA gains the IVC inflow (sinus venarum). AML hinge back on the mitral annulus; new aortomitral_curtain (fibrous, label MV_AML) joins it to the posterior aortic annulus. LAA moved lower beside the PA.

0.4.0 (P1.5, RV): RV rebuilt as a lofted ellipse along the heart Z axis (RV_cavity.loft): widest at the tricuspid level, power-law taper to an apex at z≈7 (short of the LV apex at 8.5–9.4), shifted toward the diaphragmatic side so the RV forms the inferior border (lecture) and fills the subcostal near field; carved by the LV → crescent in short axis, triangle in A4C. RV base = tricuspid annulus plane, open to the RA (no wall across the TV orifice). Moderator band moved to the lower third (septum → anterior papillary region). RVOT conus starts at 11.4 o'clock (out of the A4C plane). Fossa ovalis: thin membrane in the IAS whose thickness follows the RA phase (0.24 cm ED → 0.12 cm late systole): A4C drop-out is partial and intermittent, never a whole-beat gap.

0.4.0 (P1.5, great vessels): aortic root with three sinuses of Valsalva (trefoil bulge at the cusp directions, narrower commissures) and a sinotubular junction; aortic arch as a swept tube from the ascending aorta over the RPA to the descending aorta (overlapping the extracardiac descending aorta so the join stays closed in LLD); three arch branches (brachiocephalic, left common carotid, left subclavian) as 3 cm stumps; PA trunk now bifurcates into RPA (under the arch, behind the ascending aorta and SVC, over the LA roof) and LPA. New label ids aortic_arch, arch_branches, RPA, LPA. Root fix: the sinus term used distance to the infinite axis (the ascending aorta became an endless cylinder); now the clamped axis point. 3D bake box enlarged to hold the branches.

0.4.0 (P1.5, atria detail): right auricle = broad triangular pouch (two tapering lobes from a wide base: apex over the right side of the aortic root, lower corner along the AV groove); crista terminalis = muscular ridge inside the lateral RA wall from the front of the SVC opening to the front of the IVC opening (new label id crista_terminalis); coronary sinus = tapering tube from the great cardiac vein along the posterior AV groove, widening to an ostium that opens into the RA between the IVC and the TV; fossa ovalis with a thicker limbus rim; four separate pulmonary-vein ostia on the posterior LA wall (superior/inferior × left/right), flared at the opening and running out to the hila (left veins kept in front of the descending aorta). Label palette arrays 48 → 64 (48 labels now).

0.4.0 (P1.5, LV): LV cavity rebuilt as a chain of round cones through a radius profile (shoulder below the annulus, widest at 30 % of the length, bullet taper; exact distances so the wall stays even to the apex; same ED size 4.8 × 8.5 cm) instead of an ellipsoid smooth-unioned with a cone (removed the seam); light apical trabeculation of the endocardium; papillary muscles = tapered bodies rooted in the mid-LV wall with 2–3 heads each, tips raised to ≈2.5 cm below the annulus, moving with the wall; chordae tendineae (new label id chordae, fibrous, 0.12 cm) from every head to the nearer half of both mitral leaflets' free edges, following the leaflets through the beat.

0.4.0 (P1.5, valves): mitral orifice opened (the LV wall had formed a 0.3 cm muscle plate across the orifice above the annulus); leaflet SDF fixed (the commissural arc was not removed before projecting, so every leaflet had ~half its width); MV leaflets rebuilt from the annulus (hinges on a saddle-shaped annulus 0.6 cm high, closed direction at a coaptation point in the posterior third 0.55 cm into the LV, +0.3 cm coaptation overlap: closed MV now seals); PML scallops P1–P3, shallow A1–A3; third tricuspid leaflet (posterior) and all three TV leaflets aimed at a central coaptation point, TV annulus ring; aortic and pulmonary cusps rebuilt as bellies with vertical coaptation walls along the Y (closed) that tilt into the sinuses (open), commissural posts; PSAX-AV plane now at AV_coaptation (0.8 cm above the annulus). New label ids TV_posterior, TV_annulus.

0.4.0 (P1.5, surface): coronary arteries (19 vessels, right-dominant, SCCT segment numbers and territories: LM, LAD with D1/D2, septal perforators S1–S3 and apical wrap; LCx with OM1/OM2; RCA with conus, SA nodal, RV branches, acute marginal, AV nodal, PDA, posterolateral), cardiac veins (great, middle, small → coronary sinus) and epicardial fat in the AV and interventricular grooves, designed on the baked heart's grooves by tools/coronary_design.py and snapped to the surface. Detail levels: echo/cut face = proximal coronaries + AV-groove fat; 3D bake = + all groove fat; the full tree is swept as smooth tubes from the same centrelines in the 3D view and the mesh export. Pericardium follows the heart + fat. New label ids LCA, RCA, cardiac_veins, epicardial_fat.

0.4.0 (P1.5, export): vessels drawn thicker in the 3D heart (×2.2, ≥0.32 cm wide, lifted onto the surface) so they can be tapped; true radii unchanged for echo/angiography. tools/export_heart_mesh.py writes export/heart-mesh.json (positions, normals, index; per vertex: structure label, wall class, AHA 17 segment, standard and model coronary territory, nearest artery + position along it, motion weight; artery/vein centrelines with true and display radii; heart→body and heart→heart-3d-model matrices). export/heart-mesh-loader.js decodes it for the other labs (mesh, tappable tubes, colourBy, pick, infarctDownstream).

0.4.0 (P1.5, PLAX fix 8 Nov): aortomitral curtain is a 2.6 cm sheet from the posterior aortic annulus; AML hinge moved onto the line of the posterior aortic wall (0.6 cm below the annulus; closed leaflet re-aimed at the same coaptation point); anterior ±60° of the mitral ring removed (D-shaped annulus); LVOT clipped to the ventricular side of the curtain; LA kept off the LVOT by a fibrous band. Fixes the PLAX hole between LA and LVOT and the narrow LVOT. Sources: Netter 226/227 (aortomitral continuity), lecture; curtain length teaching (verify).

patient._note: Body-fixed frame, patient supine. Origin = skin at the suprasternal notch.

heart._note: Right-handed. All cardiac landmarks/shapes below are in this frame. Engine transform: p_patient = origin + x_h*X + y_h*Y + z_h*Z.

axes.X: from LV toward RV / septum (≈ anterior-right): the 'S' axis
axes.Y: inferior-posterior (diaphragmatic side, coronary sinus side). -Y = anterior-superior (LVOT/aorta side)

heart.teachingNote: A4C plane ≈ X–Z plane (Y≈0). Tilting the beam toward -Y opens the LVOT (A5C); toward +Y shows the coronary sinus (pitfall).

landmarks_heart._note: End-diastolic positions (heart frame, cm). Engine animates them via 'cycle'.

axes_heart._aortic_root_note: Unit vector from AV annulus toward ascending aorta (patient: right, superior, anterior).

AV_cusp_dirs._note: Unit vectors ⟂ aortic_root from AV_center toward each cusp's belly (closed). RCC anterior, LCC left (PA side), NCC right-posterior (IAS side).

_sdf_vocabulary.capsule: {a, b, r} or {points:[...], r} for a chain
_sdf_vocabulary.shell: {of, offset, thickness} — offset surface of another structure
_sdf_vocabulary.leaflet: {hinge, dirClosed, length, width, thickness, openAxis, openAngleParam}
_sdf_vocabulary.tube: {points:[...], r, rTip?} — swept tube along a polyline: round cones between points (radius tapers r → rTip), joints smooth-blended. Used for RVOT/conus, LAA; next: vessels, coronaries.
_sdf_vocabulary.envelope: gHeartD: signed distance to the heart's outer surface, written by scene() and baked for the 3D mesh (not used by the echo).

structures._animation: Any numeric value may be replaced by {param:'name'} referencing cycle.params; ED values shown as defaults.

bullet._note: Cavity = smooth union of the ellipsoid with a round cone (base radius = LV_semiXY, apex cap 0.6 cm) → bullet shape with a conical apex; apical wall thins to 80%.

loft._note: Smooth bullet as a chain of round cones through a radius profile ([z/LV length, r/rB]); widest at 30 % of the length, ED 4.8 × 8.5 cm (Lang 2015 LVEDD 4.2–5.8 men; verify); last radius 0.2·rB = 0.48 cm rounds the apex. Apical trabeculation amplitude 0.07 cm.

LVOT.label: LVOT
LVOT._note: Tube along the aortic root axis, 2.0 cm wide (Lang 2015 LVOT ~2.0 cm, verify), bounded by the basal IVS (anterior, continuous with the anterior aortic wall) and the AML (posterior, continuous with the posterior aortic wall).

anteriorWall._note: aorto-septal continuity: the basal IVS runs on into the anterior aortic wall (only the last 1.2 cm below the annulus)

regions._note: AHA segments assigned by angle around Z in the X–Y plane (0° = -Y direction / anterior-superior, increasing toward +X / septum) and by Z level: basal z<2.8, mid 2.8–5.6, apical >5.6.

RV_cavity.label: RV
RV_cavity._note: Inner semi-axes = outer (4.6, 3.0, 4.6) minus free-wall 0.4. Crescent wraps the septum; basal diameter ≈3.4 cm at TV level.

loft._note: Outer surface (incl. 0.4 cm free wall). Semi-axes taper as t^1.8 from the TV level to the apex → triangular RV in A4C, crescent in SAX after the LV carve. Targets (Lang 2015, verify): basal diameter 2.5–4.1, mid 1.9–3.5, length 5.9–8.3 cm; RV apex short of the LV apex.

RVOT.label: RVOT
RVOT._note: Conus arteriosus: curved tube from the RV inflow (TV side, 10 o'clock round the AV) over the front of the aortic root to the PV (2 o'clock), so in PSAX-AV the RV/RVOT wraps the Mercedes sign from 9 to 2 o'clock. Netter 220/224/226; Lang 2015 RVOT prox 2.0-3.0 cm (verify).

LA.label: LA
LA._note: ED (post-atrial-kick) is near-minimum; AP diameter ≈3.0 ED, ≈3.6 at end-systole.

detail._note: Organic atrium: ellipsoid + funnel (vestibule) to the mitral annulus + pulmonary-vein ostia + LAA, low-frequency wobble so it is never a perfect sphere; clipped at the annulus plane.

LA._sizeNote: ED (minimum, after atrial kick) semi 2.3/1.8/2.6 cm → A4C width ≈4.6, length ≈5.2, PLAX AP ≈3.6 cm; ES ×1.08 → ≈52 mL + vestibule/veins. Lang 2015 LA AP 3.0–4.0 cm, LAVi max 16–34 mL/m² (verify).

RA.label: RA

raa._note: Right auricle: broad triangular pouch (two tapering lobes from a wide base: apex over the right side of the aortic root, lower corner along the AV groove), Netter 216/224; lecture: RA appendage.

detail._note: RA + vestibule to the TV + SVC (toward the head) + broad RA appendage (anterior); IVC joins from below (extracardiac).

ivc._note: Sinus venarum: the IVC opens into the posterior-inferior RA (the extracardiac IVC's last point, heart frame).

crista._note: Crista terminalis: smooth ridge inside the lateral RA wall between the smooth sinus venarum (behind) and the pectinate muscles (front); on the outside it matches the sulcus terminalis (Netter 218/224; lecture).

RA._sizeNote: ED semi 2.0/1.8/2.5 cm → A4C minor ≈4.0, major ≈5.0 cm, ≈38 mL. Lang 2015 RA minor 2.9–4.5 cm, major ≈4.4–5.3 cm (verify).

IAS.rule: wall where LA and RA walls meet (smoothUnion k=0.6)

fossaOvalis._note: Thin membrane (posterior-inferior IAS). Thickness follows the RA phase: 0.24 cm at ED, 0.12 cm in late systole → A4C drop-out is intermittent, never all beat (a whole-beat gap = ASD).

rim._note: Limbus: thicker muscular rim round the thin fossa (Netter 224).

IAS.label: IAS

LAA.label: LAA
LAA._note: Left auricle: tapering finger, LA → anterior-left, tip beside the PA trunk (Netter 216/218; lecture: left auricle).

pulmonary_veins._note: Four separate ostia on the posterior LA wall (left/right × superior/inferior), each flaring to ≈1.4 cm at the opening (r 0.72 → 0.55 cm), running out to the hila; right veins pass behind the RA/SVC (Netter 218/219; lecture: LA receives 4 pulmonary veins). Teaching sizes (verify).

coronary_sinus.label: Coronary sinus
coronary_sinus._note: Great cardiac vein → coronary sinus in the posterior AV groove → ostium in the RA between the IVC opening and the TV (Netter 218/222/224; lecture: coronary sinus empties into the RA).

MV_annulus._tiltNote: Annulus plane tilted ~27° from ⟂ LV axis: the posterior (PML) hinge sits ~0.8 cm more basal than the anterior (AML) hinge, so in PLAX the closed MV runs diagonally from the aortic root toward the AV groove instead of a vertical line.

saddle._note: Saddle-shaped (hyperbolic paraboloid) annulus: anterior (aortic) and posterior points 0.3 cm toward the atrium, commissures 0.3 cm toward the LV → annular height ≈0.6 cm, AHCWR ≈20 % (normal ~15–25 %; teaching, verify).
saddle._leafletNote: Leaflet hinges follow half the ring's saddle (0.15 cm): the leaflet hinge line sits just ventricular of the ring crest, and a full 0.3 cm lift took the PML out of the PSAX-MV plane.

MV_annulus._gapNote: No ring over the anterior ±50°: the anterior mitral annulus is the aortomitral curtain (fibrous continuity), the ring is C-shaped posteriorly (Netter; teaching, verify).

MV_AML.label: AML
MV_AML._note: Hinge on the anterior annulus in fibrous continuity with the AV (non-coronary/left cusps).
MV_AML._shapeNote: Curved, tapered leaflet: centre-line bows toward bowClosed (systole, billowing into the LA) or bowOpen (diastole); widthCurl bends the free edge back toward the annulus so the short-axis cut is an arc (fish mouth).

scallops._note: A1/A2/A3: no true clefts, only shallow indentations facing P1/P2/P3.

MV_AML._closureNote: Hinge on the annulus, closed direction aimed at the coaptation point (posterior third of the orifice, 0.55 cm into the LV: normal tenting), length = hinge→coaptation + 0.3 cm coaptation overlap, so the closed leaflets seal the orifice.
MV_AML._hingeNote: P1.5 fix (PLAX): hinge on the line of the posterior aortic wall, 0.6 cm below the posterior aortic annulus (aortomitral curtain), so the posterior aortic wall runs on into the AML and the LVOT keeps its width. It sits inside the old ring: the anterior side of the D-shaped mitral annulus is the aortomitral continuity. Closed direction re-aimed at the same coaptation point.

MV_PML.label: PML

scallops._note: P1 (anterolateral) / P2 / P3 (posteromedial) separated by clefts (Carpentier nomenclature).

MV_PML._closureNote: Hinge on the annulus, closed direction aimed at the coaptation point (posterior third of the orifice, 0.55 cm into the LV: normal tenting), length = hinge→coaptation + 0.3 cm coaptation overlap, so the closed leaflets seal the orifice.

chordae.label: chordae
chordae._note: Thin strands from each papillary head to the nearer half of both mitral leaflets' free edges; endpoints follow the leaflets through the beat. 0.12 cm thick: faint on echo, never solid sheets.

papillary_muscles._note: Two LV papillary muscles (anterolateral, posteromedial), tapered bodies rooted in the mid-LV wall with 2–3 heads each; they move with the wall. Netter 225/227; lecture: LV papillary muscles (anterior, posterior).

TV_annulus._note: TV is ≈0.8 cm more apical than MV (normal apical offset).

aortic_root._profile_note: [distance along axis, radius]: annulus 2.3 → sinus 3.2 → STJ 2.7 → ascending 2.9 cm diameters.

sinuses._note: Three sinuses of Valsalva bulge at the cusp directions (trefoil root); sinus diameter ≈3.3, STJ ≈2.7 cm (Lang 2015 3.4±0.3 / 2.9±0.3 men, verify).

AV_cusps._note: Closed in diastole → 'Mercedes-Benz' Y in PSAX-AV; open in systole → triangular orifice.
AV_cusps._bellyNote: Closed cusps sag toward the LV at the centre (belly), so the coaptation line is curved in PLAX/A5C.

commissures._note: Commissural posts on the root wall between the cusps, annulus → sinotubular junction (Netter 226).

bellies._note: Closed: bellies hang from the sinus wall (rim 0.55 cm above the annulus) sagging 0.35 cm toward the LV, and turn up into 0.6 cm vertical coaptation walls along the Y (0.55–1.15 cm). PSAX-AV cuts at AV_coaptation (0.8 cm) → Mercedes sign; bellies just below.

PV_cusps.label: PV
PV_cusps._note: Three semilunar cusps (anterior, left, right; lecture) closing as a Y like the AV; open = folded to the wall.

pericardium.label: Pericardium

space._note: Normal = 0 (physiologic fluid not rendered). Pathology pack sets >0.

pericardium._posteriorNote: Posterior (AV-groove / inferolateral) pericardium is thicker and brighter, as in the PLAX far field; elsewhere it stays thin so chambers don't get white rims.

aortomitral_curtain.label: MV_AML
aortomitral_curtain._note: Fibrous continuity between the posterior aortic annulus (NCC/LCC) and the AML hinge on the mitral annulus (~1-1.5 cm). Seals the LVOT from the LA; in PLAX the AML runs on from the posterior aortic wall. Netter 226/227.
aortomitral_curtain._sheetNote: Sheet a→b, 2.6 cm wide between the fibrous trigones, 0.2 cm thick. The LVOT is clipped to its ventricular side and the LA carved behind it (P1.5 fix: PLAX hole between LA and LVOT).

aortic_arch.label: aortic_arch
aortic_arch._note: Ascending end (Ao_asc_end) → arch over the RPA and left bronchus → descending aorta (overlaps the extracardiac descending aorta by 1.5 cm so the join stays closed in LLD). Body-frame design points (cm): top of arch ≈2 cm below the suprasternal notch (manubrium level, lecture: arch at the sternal angle plane T4), descending start left-anterior of the spine as in the CT (≈2.4 cm wide). Converted to the heart frame.

arch_branches.label: arch_branches
arch_branches._note: Stumps ≈3 cm (as on a heart specimen, Netter 215/216). Order right→left: brachiocephalic trunk, left common carotid, left subclavian (lecture). Sizes teaching (verify).

PA_branches._note: RPA runs right, under the arch, behind the ascending aorta and SVC to the right hilum; LPA runs left and back over the left bronchus (Netter 216/218; lecture). Main PA ≈2.4, branches ≈1.6 cm (teaching, verify).

TV_posterior.label: TV (posterior)
TV_posterior._note: Third (inferior/posterior) tricuspid leaflet; the three leaflets meet at a central coaptation point (Netter 224; lecture: tricuspid valve).

arteries.name: Left anterior descending (proximal → mid → distal, wraps the apex)
arteries.label: LCA

arteries.name: Left circumflex (proximal → distal, in the left AV groove)
arteries.label: LCA

arteries.name: Right coronary (proximal → mid → distal, in the right AV groove to the crux)
arteries.label: RCA

arteries.name: Posterior descending (inferior interventricular)
arteries.territory: inferior wall, inferior 1/3 of the septum
arteries.label: RCA

arteries.name: AV nodal branch
arteries.territory: AV node (base of the atrial septum)
arteries.label: RCA

coronary_arteries._note: Designed on the baked heart by tools/coronary_design.py (run again after any change to the outer shape). Right-dominant pattern (Netter 223, BP52): LM → LAD (diagonals, septal perforators, wraps the apex) + LCx (OMs, in the left AV groove); RCA (conus, SA nodal, RV branches, acute marginal, AV nodal, PDA, posterolateral). 'scct' = SCCT/AHA segment number(s); 'territory' = the myocardium it supplies (for the MI lab). Radii (cm) teaching values after Dodge 1992 (verify): LM 0.23, proximal LAD 0.19, LCx 0.17, RCA 0.20.

display._note: 3D heart / MI lab only: vessels drawn thicker than life (×2.2, at least 0.32 cm wide) so they can be tapped, and lifted onto the surface. True radii (r0/r1) stay for the echo, the cut face and the angiogram.

cardiac_veins._note: Great cardiac vein (anterior IV groove → left AV groove), middle cardiac vein (inferior IV groove), small cardiac vein (right AV groove), all draining into the coronary sinus → RA (Netter 218/222; lecture).

epicardial_fat._note: Fat filling the AV and interventricular grooves (vessels run inside it). Echo: faint, mid-grey; 3D: yellow in the grooves.

extracardiac_patient._note: Patient frame (cm). These do NOT move with the heart in LLD (only the body rolls).

torso._note: Anterior skin z = -11 + 11*sqrt(1-(x/16)^2). Visual mesh may be nicer; echo uses this surface for probe contact.

chest_wall._note: Skin 0.2 + fat/muscle 1.0 → bright layered near field.

ribs._note: Anterior rib arcs follow the chest surface at depth 1.0 (centre). Rib n centre y at |x|: y = -0.875 - 2.25*n - 0.25*max(0, |x|-3). ICS n (between rib n and n+1) centre: y = -2.0 - 2.25*n - 0.25*max(0,|x|-3). Example at parasternal x=3: ICS2 -6.5, ICS3 -8.75, ICS4 -11.0, ICS5 -13.25. Width 1.0 → intercostal gap ≈1.25 cm (a phased-array footprint fits, edge beams may clip ribs = realistic edge shadows).
ribs.cartilage: medial to the junction; ribs 6–7 cartilage curves down to meet the sternum at y≈-17; ribs 8–10 join the costal margin

descending_aorta._note: Sits just behind the LA/AV groove → visible in PLAX far field; abdominal part lies LEFT of the IVC (IVC-view pitfall).

liver.label: Liver
liver._note: Left lobe sits under the xiphoid → acoustic window for subxiphoid views.

stomach_gas._note: Blocks a subxiphoid probe placed too far left (POCUS101 pitfall).

lungs._note: Anterior lung edges are where most 'no image' moments come from — tune so parasternal ICS3–4 and apical windows are partly open supine and clearly open in LLD.

tissues._note: Shader lookup. brightness = mean echo amplitude (0–1) before speckle; transmit = fraction of energy passing beyond (1 = no shadow); speckleCm = speckle grain size; edgeBoost = specular interface brightness.

imaging_defaults.speckleSeeding: hash(world position quantised to speckleCm) → Rayleigh sample; re-seeded slowly (decorrelation 0.1/frame) so it shimmers like real tissue

cycle._timing_note: t is fraction of RR from R peak. At 70 bpm (RR 857 ms): IVC 0–0.06, ejection 0.06–0.38, IVR 0.38–0.47, rapid filling (E) 0.47–0.62, diastasis 0.62–0.86, atrial contraction (A) 0.86–1.0.
cycle.HR_scaling: Keep systole (t 0→0.47 at 70 bpm = 400 ms) as systoleMs = 400 - 1.6*(HR-70), clamped 300–420 ms; compress/expand diastasis first, then rapid filling.

params._LV_check: Diastole: EDD 4.8, wall 0.9, length 8.5 (apex endo 8.5). Systole: ESD 3.2, wall 1.4, length 8.4-1.3 = 7.1–7.2, MAPSE 1.3 → EF (Teichholz-ish) ≈ 60%.
params._TAPSE_note: Lateral TV annulus excursion 2.0 cm (normal TAPSE ≥1.7).

ecg._note: Sum of Gaussians on t (wrap at 1.0). amp in mV-ish units; draw as a green trace with moving cursor; ED marker at R, ES marker at end of T.

respiration._note: Spontaneous breathing. t_resp 0 = start of inspiration, 0.4 = end-inspiration.
respiration._IVC_note: Diameter 1.8 cm, ~50% inspiratory collapse → normal RAP (ASE: ≤2.1 cm & >50% → RAP ≈3).

heartShift_y_cm._note: Optional realism: heart descends slightly on inspiration.

LLD._roll_note: Whole body rotates about the patient y axis, left side down (rendering). Heart offset below is relative to the thorax (gravity).
LLD._rotate_note: Positive = apex swings laterally/posteriorly; apical window moves toward the anterior axillary line.
LLD.armPose: left arm abducted above head (opens ICS by ribs.LLD_icsWidening_cm)
LLD.teachingTooltip: In left lateral decubitus the heart falls toward the left chest wall and the lingula slides away, so the parasternal and apical windows open up and the apex moves lateral.

palette_anatomyTint._note: Shared by echo 'Anatomy tint' overlay and the inset cut face (alpha ~0.35 on echo).

_mesh._note: 3D heart bake (scene.js): voxel size and smoothing. 0.13 cm keeps 0.4 cm walls ≥3 voxels; bake ≈1.3 s in SwiftShader.
_mesh._boxNote: Heart-frame bake box (cm); must contain the arch branches and PA branches (validator checks).
